decision: reproduced: CacheX.4294967296 cached as CacheX.0 lets a false CacheX.0 reuse a stored key

decision: numeric name parts encoded at full length; a cached module is reused only if its entry names exactly the constants it owns now and none is declared by another module

decision: replay turns on kernel diagnostics and stores no verdict for a check that unfolded a theorem

decision: LEAN_NAT_MAX_SIZE goes into the key prefix

decision: mdata (with Syntax payloads as structEq compares them) and let nondep are now hashed

decision: nested blocks never skip while a constant is named under _nested; Bool.false added to the constants the kernel uses by name
